title: Wizard happy path
preconditions: `npm run clear:itinerary` if needed. Open `itinerary.html`. Prefer a future in-season visit date with animals offered.
cleanup: `npm run clear:itinerary` or **Clear Itinerary?** when done.

steps.name: Open itinerary
steps.do: Open `itinerary.html`. Use **Edit Itinerary** / **Build Itinerary** to open the builder if needed.
steps.expect: Itinerary page loads; builder can be opened.

steps.name: Set Visit Date
steps.expect: Date is accepted; next wizard step appears.

steps.name: Add Animals by Region
steps.do: On **Add Animals by Region**, select at least one region/exhibit and continue.
steps.expect: Selection is kept; proceed to animals.

steps.name: Add Animals
steps.expect: Animal appears selected in the builder.

steps.name: Add Attractions
steps.do: On **Add Attractions**, add 0 or 1 attraction and continue.

steps.name: Meet the Guardians
steps.do: On the Meet the Guardians step, add a talk if listed, else continue.
steps.expect: Pass with Notes “none offered” if empty for the date.

steps.name: Wild Encounters
steps.do: On **Wild Encounters**, add one if listed, else continue.
steps.expect: Pass with Notes “none offered” if empty.

steps.name: Add Transportation
steps.do: On **Add Transportation**, add or skip, then continue toward finish.

steps.name: List view
steps.expect: Sections show selected animals (and other types if chosen); **List View** control is available.

steps.name: Day Planner view
steps.do: Switch to **Day Planner View** if not already shown.
steps.expect: Day Planner / timeline UI is available (**Arrival time**, **Departure time**, scheduled/unscheduled sections).

steps.name: Map pane markers
steps.do: Look at the itinerary map pane.
steps.expect: Planned item markers appear on the map.
